Resolves #21633

Tightens the `< 390px` base tier in `resources/css/src/apps/portal/HeaderToolbar.css` (`--button-min-width: 30px`, `--button-padding: 0 4px`, `.no-text` / `.logo` `width: 30px`, `.portal-header-actions` `margin-left: 2px`) so all 8 header buttons stay inside a `360 px` viewport (`Join Discord.right: 360.7 px → 355 px`, `height: 48 px >= 44 px`) even when `fonts.googleapis.com` (`"Source Sans 3"`) is blocked or has not swapped yet (`fallback sans-serif`), leaving `>= 390 px` viewports unchanged.

Evidence: L2 (`HeaderToolbarPhoneNL.spec.mjs` `6/6` including blocked-`fonts.googleapis.com` arm + `360 × 844` before/after frames) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-3). Residual: none.

Prescription checked: `resources/css/src/apps/portal/HeaderToolbar.css` — owns the concern (the `< 390px` vs `390–640px` responsive token split for `.portal-header-toolbar`; authored in this session per `self-authored-carve.md`).

agent-preflight: not hosted here (`restoration`); shared baseline `PR baseline` + `guards` run in CI.
